title: conventions-enforcer spec FAILs files outside plan.md Modules touched, contradicting v0.10.0 derived-modules convention
detail: prusik/templates/.claude/agents/conventions-enforcer.md Step 0 'Worktree completeness' tells the reviewer to FAIL any changed file not in plan.md ## Modules touched. Since v0.10.0 Fix 1 the list is derived: schema._NON_SUBSTANTIVE_SECTIONS holds '## Modules touched' and gate.py (~2033) compares the actual diff against scope and records drift as a non-blocking modules_reconciled event. Surfaced in model-tier-policy round 4: a reviewer FAILed a legitimately discovered prusik/schema.py fix, costing a full review round. The spec should key completeness to the same scope-vs-diff reconciliation the gate uses.

resolution.verify: uv run python -m pytest tests/test_one_modules_parser.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
